source_prompt: Open-ended feedback on the survey itself or on technology adoption barriers.
selection_method: Quotes will be curated by the principal investigator from the full set of 162 open-ended responses. Pseudonymous IDs (P + first 6 of the Qualtrics response ID hash) replace any direct identifier. Verbatim quotes undergo a PII-risk scan (zero email/phone/URL/explicit-employer mentions detected in the source) and a manual review for sector specificity before inclusion. Edited excerpts are flagged with edited=true.
_seed: Initial seed - no curated quotes yet. Stats are real (computed from local extraction). Run promote_q74_to_repo.py from the local curation workflow to populate quotes.
